result.pretraining: Public CLIP ViT-B/16, fresh identity heads, no historical research weights
result.checkpoint_rule: Maximum full official query/gallery mAP across 50 epochs; ties keep earliest epoch
result.evaluation_scope: Entire official training split and entire official query/gallery; no fit/dev holdout
result.selection_limitation: Official benchmark is used for checkpoint selection; this is not an untouched independent final test
result.method_revision: RGBNT100 existing DeMo ATMoE heads=8; paper B128/K16/50epochs, public CLIP fresh baseline, seed42. Relative to the same head B64 candidate only training batch changes. P8K16 differs from prior frozen-expert P8K8 and changes update count. All8675 training records/full1715Q8575G; normal benchmark mAP best earliest ties. Actual attempts/updates/skips disclosed, no equal-update claim or expert gain. Finite heads8/32 comparison, no new module/loss, RGBNT201 or missing evaluation. Paper acceptance87.2mAP/98.6Rank-1; all six metrics from one checkpoint.
result.amp_policy: Native fp16 GradScaler512; actual optimizer updates and skipped steps recorded
result.retention: Only best.pth; smoke strict reload in memory; no initial, last, or smoke weight files
